method: Largest-remainder allocation proportional to existing split x target counts; select smallest SHA256(seed:respondent_id) within each stratum. No prediction/performance filtering. Preserve all source columns and original field strings.
eligibility: Existing non-quarantine train/validation/test rows only. No new exclusions or relabeling.
evaluation: Existing validation and test memberships retained. These are historically reused internal splits, not independent new evidence. No accuracy target guaranteed and no model training performed.
